title: IBM Power Systems Firmware FW1120.00 through FW1120.01, FW1110.00 through FW1110.31, FW1060.00 through FW1060.81,…
description: A vulnerability in IBM Power Systems Firmware versions FW1120.00 through FW1120.01, FW1110.00 through FW1110.31, FW1060.00 through FW1060.81, OP940.00 through OP940.A2, OP910.00 through OP910.95, and OP940.00 through OP940.82 allows a remote attacker to cause a denial of service due to improper handling of uninitialized resources. The flaw does not impact confidentiality or integrity but can disrupt availability.
